verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents generic card products, card creation, JIT funding and virtual card issuance. None of it names support for debit, prepaid, commercial credit, or consumer credit programs as distinct card types. Generic statements about crafting card products do not show the multi-program coverage the story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform supports the card types my product needs — debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit programs — not just one prepaid rail
